### A Prayer to Appreciate God’s Blessings
Author: Victoria Riollano
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-to-appreciate-gods-blessings.html
Passage: Genesis 25:34
Points:
- Esau surrendered long-term inheritance and family authority merely to soothe immediate hunger.
- Daily irritations and unmet expectations easily tempt people to treat God's gifts with contempt.
- Believers dishonor God when they fail to recognize and treasure what He has provided.
- Christians should actively choose gratitude over resentment, asking God for wisdom to steward His blessings well.

### A Despised Birthright
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/despised-birthright
Passage: Genesis 25:32-34
Points:
- The patriarchal birthright carried clan leadership as well as covenantal promises of redemption.
- Esau lived impulsively in the moment, trading eternal blessings for temporary physical comfort.
- Although Jacob schemed selfishly to obtain the birthright, God still worked through events to fulfill His sovereign plan.
- Believers must remain vigilant against bodily appetites that can subtly erode their spiritual inheritance.
